feeds.title: National Observer
feeds.description: Canada's National Observer publishes investigative reporting, in-depth analysis, solutions journalism, multi-media features, opinion, and daily news coverage. We are committed to producing journalism that is accurate, fair, and complete, and our journalists strive to act with honesty, transparency, and independence.

feeds.title: Rabble.ca
feeds.description: An essential part of a balanced media diet, rabble.ca is the go-to site for progressive journalism and dialogue about national politics and social movements. We publish news and opinion that ensures readers can engage with the most pressing political issues of our time through a range of progressive views. We work to introduce readers to tomorrow's public intellectuals, tomorrow's leaders, and tomorrow's bright new ideas or visions.

feeds.title: The Logic News
feeds.description: At The Logic, we believe the best days of journalism are ahead of us, with readers at our core. We are committed to providing intelligent, nuanced and insightful journalism. We report with compassion, fairness and facts. We aren't out to score cheap shots or take snarky jabs. Our community deserves better. We treat our readers the way we all deserve to be treated: with honesty, humility, a sense of humour and, most of all, with humanity.s

feeds.title: Journalists for Human Rights
feeds.description: Journalists for Human Rights (JHR) is Canada's leading media development organization. We train journalists to report on human rights and governance issues in their communities.

feeds.title: Edmonton Journal
feeds.description: Edmonton Journal provide relevant and reliable news and information to the Edmonton community. They remain Edmonton's most trusted voice, providing a professional perspective on news, business, sports and entertainment that's read by more northern Albertans than any other daily newspaper.

feeds.title: Carleton News
feeds.description: What began as a small School with one Journalism program and seven students in 1945 has grown into an innovative and diverse multi-program community some 1,900-strong.

feeds.title: Halifax Examiner » Journalism
feeds.description: The Halifax Examiner was founded by investigative reporter Tim Bousquet. Bousquet is responsible for fearless investigative reporting that makes a difference, and the Halifax Examiner continues that tradition. It is an independent, adversarial news site devoted to holding the powerful accountable.

feeds.title: Fagstein Blog
feeds.description: Hi. My name's Steve Faguy. I'm a thirty-something geek freelance journalist who lives in Montreal. This blog is about my various thoughts.

feeds.title: Seneca Journalism
feeds.description: Seneca Journalism is dedicated to Journalism, featuring articles on current affairs and trends from Canada and around the world. Other major news categories to explore are Lifestyle, Health, Sports, and more delivering news with accuracy and sincerity.

feeds.title: Global Journalism Innovation Lab News
feeds.description: The Global Journalism Innovation Lab researches new approaches to journalism. Our research teams are looking at how new revenue models, new policy frameworks, and new modes of audience engagement can support informed, knowledge-based journalism so that it can continue to fulfill its essential public role in the 21st century.

feeds.title: World Federation of Science Journalists
feeds.description: With a clear mission, vision, and path forward, the World Federation of Science Journalists continues to be a pillar of the Science Journalism community. The WFSJ encourages strong, critical coverage of issues in science and technology, the environment, health and medicine, agriculture, and related fields.

feeds.title: Academic Matters
feeds.description: Academic Matters explores issues of relevance to higher education in Ontario, other provinces in Canada, and globally. It is a forum for a thoughtful and thought-provoking, original, and engaging discussion of current trends in postsecondary education and consideration of academe's future direction.

feeds.title: The Thunderbird
feeds.description: The Thunderbird is the award-winning student publication of the Graduate School of Journalism at the University of British Columbia. It showcases the work of the students in the Integrated Journalism course. The course offers an integrated approach to journalism education, with students taught to be able to work across print, broadcast, and online mediums.

feeds.title: The Griffins' Nest
feeds.description: The Griffins' Nest is Eric Hamber's student-led, independent newspaper. Publishing all year round, Our team of student journalists work to research, write, and edit articles on a wide variety of topics and issues for Hamber's newspaper of record for distribution it to the student body and community. We take pride in our history of exceptional work by our reporters.

feeds.title: SteveSilva.ca
feeds.description: My name is Steve Silva. I live in Iqaluit, Nunavut, Canada. Telling stories, especially via video, is my passion. I've worked for CBC News, Global News, and OpenFile. My work has appeared in the Etobicoke Guardian, Jimmy Kimmel Live!, Moyers & Company, The Canadian Press, and the Toronto Star. I earned a bachelor of journalism degree from Ryerson University in 2012.

feeds.title: Waubgeshig Rice
feeds.description: Waubgeshig Rice is an author and journalist originally from Wasauksing First Nation. Waub got his first taste of journalism in 1996 as an exchange student in Germany. He graduated from Ryerson University's journalism program in 2002. He's worked in a variety of news media since, reporting for CBC News for the bulk of his career.

feeds.title: Joey Coleman
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Joey Coleman, a journalist in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada who is an open data activist, engaged citizen, and proud blogger. This is my personal website or the place I try to break the Internet, which does include archives of my pre-2014 journalistic activities, and personal blog posts going back to November 2004.

feeds.title: The Narwhal
feeds.description: The Narwhal's team of investigative journalists dives deep to tell stories about Canada's natural environment you can't find anywhere else except their blog. We tell stories Canada's big news outlets miss and hustle to help our readers make sense of complex issues. As a non-profit online magazine, our goal is to bring evidence-based news and analysis to the surface for all Canadians.

feeds.title: Consider This
feeds.description: This is a site about journalism, in practice and in theory. In particular it is about hyperocal news: the creation, distribution and consumption of news in hamlets, villages, towns and small cities in rural Canada. Through its journalism and other materials, it explores providing journalism to these audiences.

feeds.title: Ricochet Media
feeds.description: Ricochet is an audacious response to a difficult context. Independent, dedicated to investigative journalism and incisive opinion, Ricochet seeks to illuminate the cultural and political diversity within Canada.
